data.text:
Worlwide Dreamcorp Limited Through Its ... vs Food Safety And 
Standard Authority Of ... on 22 November, 2024 
Author: Pranay Verma
Bench: Pranay Verma
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:33157
 1 W
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma
 On The 22nd Of November, 2024
 Writ Petition No. 23035 of 2023
 Worlwide Dreamcorp Limited Through Its Nominee
 Subodh Bakore
 Versus
 Food Safety And Standard Authority Of India And
 Others
 Appearance: 
 Shri Vinayak Balchandani, learned counsel for the peti
 Shri Oshin Upadhyay, learned counsel for the responden
 Order
1. Learned counsel for respondents has submitted that the Lab report has been received and therein it has been found that the sample of the food product of petitioner has not been found to be adulterated. 
2. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned order dated 31.08.2023 (Annexure P/4) passed by respondent No.2 which was on the presumption that the sample is adulterated has lost all efficacy and cannot be permitted to stand and is accordingly quashed.
3. However in respect of the grievance of the petitioner that he has suffered loss both monitory as well as of reputation, he would be free to take recourse to such remedies as may be available to it under the law. 
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:33157 2 WP-23035-2023 4. With the aforesaid observation, petition stands allowed and disposed off.
